mapper.sql: pb.id, pb.plot_id, p.plot_name, pb.crop_id, c.crop_name, pb.user_id, u.username, u.nickname, CONCAT('Batch_', LPAD(CAST(pb.id AS CHAR), GREATEST(3, CHAR_LENGTH(CAST(pb.id AS CHAR))), '0')) AS batch_no, pb.planting_area, pb.area_unit, pb.planted_at, pb.expected_harvest_at, pb.actual_harvest_at, pb.harvester, gs.stage_order AS growth_stage, gs.id AS growth_stage_id, gs.stage_name AS growth_stage_name, pb.expected_yield_amount, CASE WHEN pb.status = 1 AND pb.planted_at IS NOT NULL THEN GREATEST(DATEDIFF(CURDATE(), pb.planted_at), 0) ELSE COALESCE(pb.grown_days, 0) END AS grown_days, COALESCE(pb.crop_image, c.image_url) AS crop_image, pb.status, pb.yield_amount, pb.yield_unit, pb.remark, pb.create_time, pb.update_time

LEFT JOIN `plot` p ON p.id = pb.plot_id LEFT JOIN `crop` c ON c.id = pb.crop_id LEFT JOIN `user` u ON u.id = pb.user_id LEFT JOIN `growth_stage` gs ON gs.id = ( SELECT gs2.id FROM `growth_stage` gs2 WHERE gs2.crop_id = pb.crop_id AND gs2.status = 1 AND CASE WHEN pb.status = 1 AND pb.planted_at IS NOT NULL THEN GREATEST(DATEDIFF(CURDATE(), pb.planted_at), 0) ELSE COALESCE(pb.grown_days, 0) END >= COALESCE(gs2.start_day, 0) AND CASE WHEN pb.status = 1 AND pb.planted_at IS NOT NULL THEN GREATEST(DATEDIFF(CURDATE(), pb.planted_at), 0) ELSE COALESCE(pb.grown_days, 0) END <= COALESCE( gs2.end_day, COALESCE(gs2.start_day, 0) + gs2.duration - 1 ) ORDER BY COALESCE(gs2.start_day, 0) DESC, gs2.stage_order DESC, gs2.id DESC LIMIT 1 )
mapper.insert:
INSERT INTO `planting_batch`
plot_id, crop_id, user_id, batch_no, planting_area, area_unit, planted_at, expected_harvest_at, actual_harvest_at, harvester, growth_stage_id, expected_yield_amount, grown_days, crop_image, status, yield_amount, yield_unit, remark,
#{plotId}, #{cropId}, #{userId}, #{batchNo}, #{plantingArea}, #{areaUnit}, #{plantedAt}, #{expectedHarvestAt}, #{actualHarvestAt}, #{harvester}, #{growthStageId}, #{expectedYieldAmount}, #{grownDays}, #{cropImage}, #{status}, #{yieldAmount}, #{yieldUnit}, #{remark},
mapper.update: UPDATE `planting_batch` SET harvester = #{harvester}, yield_amount = #{yieldAmount}, yield_unit = #{yieldUnit}, actual_harvest_at = #{actualHarvestAt}, grown_days = GREATEST(DATEDIFF(#{actualHarvestAt}, planted_at), 0), status = 2 WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 1
mapper.select: SELECT pb.* FROM `planting_batch` pb WHERE pb.plot_id = #{plotId} AND pb.status = 1 ORDER BY pb.planted_at DESC, pb.create_time DESC, pb.id DESC LIMIT 1 FOR UPDATE
